description: Final demo fleet (Track B 2026-10-10): 49 simulated chargers + the Raspberry Pi. CP0000: the PHYSICAL charger (Raspberry Pi, GPIOPower), ML-DSA capable; its id sorts first, so with canary_count >= 1 the Pi is migrated in the canary. (A dashed id such as CP-PI01 cannot be used: the profile reads 'A-B' as a range.) CP0001-CP0045: Track C agents, ML-DSA capable. CP0046-CP0049: Track C agents declared LEGACY (skipped as incompatible - the heterogeneous fleet).
